cakemap.settings.title: CakeMap settings
cakemap.settings.minimap.tip: Show the minimap on the HUD.
cakemap.settings.frame.tip: How the round minimap is framed: a thick ring with N, or a thin line.
cakemap.settings.zoom.tip: GUI pixels per block on the minimap.
cakemap.settings.rotate.tip: Turn the minimap with you, or keep north up.
cakemap.settings.corner.tip: Which corner of the screen the minimap sits in.
cakemap.settings.cave.tip: Auto: a cross-section at your height whenever there is a roof over you.
cakemap.settings.mode.tip: Static: the shard's pre-rendered map (from a resource pack) once you have been there. Dynamic: only what you have seen.
cakemap.settings.marker.head: Head
cakemap.settings.waypointsOnMinimap.tip: Bookmarked and temporary waypoints stay at the edge when far away.
cakemap.settings.waypointsInWorld.tip: Icons and distances where waypoints are on screen.
cakemap.settings.builtinInWorld.tip: Built-in waypoints (dungeons, POIs …) in the world view: only bookmarked ones, or all.
cakemap.settings.questCompass.tip: Where the quest compass points becomes a temporary waypoint (Monumenta).
cakemap.settings.deathWaypoints.tip: Mark where you die. The newest 5 are kept; older ones go by themselves.
cakemap.settings.chatCoordinates.tip: A [+] after coordinates in chat adds a temporary waypoint.
